name: Tehran

shortNote: The place where the journey begins.

name: Isfahan
label: Half of the World
description: Nesf-e Jahan — a city of beauty, geometry, and memory, where blue tilework and grand avenues seem to hold time still.

name: Stockholm

shortNote: Northern light across an island city.

name: Ankara

shortNote: A modern capital with ancient layers.

name: Antarctica
description: A white edge of the world — immense, quiet, and almost abstract in its scale.
shortNote: A white edge of the world.

name: Paris
description: A city imagined through art, long walks, quiet cafés, and the changing light along the Seine.
shortNote: Art, streets, and light along the Seine.

name: Italy
description: A future journey through art, food, architecture, and the landscapes that connect one storied city to the next.

name: Amazon Rainforest
description: A living green world of rivers, rain, and extraordinary biodiversity, vast enough to redraw one’s sense of scale.
shortNote: A green world written by rivers and rain.

name: Cape Town
description: A meeting point of mountain, ocean, layered histories, and a horizon that always seems to invite another look.
